notes: The MKR 1000 WiFi is not in the catalogue, so it is defined as a new part type with the pins labelled in the diagram (pin 8 is unlabelled in the image but included).
Resistor value: the parts list says 82 ohm, but the schematic labels it 220 Ω. I used 220 because the circuit images are the authority. Change it to 82 if you prefer the text.

Breadboard rows: the image shows rows j-f in the top half and e-a in the bottom half. The catalogue says bank 't' is rows a-e, but I named holes by the row letters shown in the image. Rows f-j are therefore bank 'b' and the holes are written like '3b.h'. The resistor and wire holes are read from the picture.

LED polarity: the bent (longer) leg is in column 6 and I took it as the anode. It connects through the resistor to pin 2. The straight leg (cathode) in column 8 goes to GND through the black wire, which ends in the same column.
The resistor spans columns 3 and 6 in row h. The green wire from pin 2 ends in column 3, row g, which is the same strip as the resistor's first leg.
The sketch's analogRead(A1) is only software. No hardware is wired to A1.
